# Kicks on Deck

> Independent online sneaker store selling transparently labelled 1:1 replica Yeezy silhouettes (350 V2, Foam Runner, Slides) with free US & Canada shipping, 7-day returns and honest, resale-free pricing. Every page says "rep" out loud; nothing here is sold as authentic.

## Key facts
- What we sell: transparently labelled 1:1 replica Yeezy silhouettes — 350 V2 knit runners, Foam Runner clogs and Slides — plus cleaning gear. 94 styles in stock. Not affiliated with adidas or Yeezy.
- Where: online store based in Treasure Coast, FL, shipping to United States & Canada.
- Prices: from $18; no resale markup.
- Shipping: free on every order to United States & Canada. Dispatched within 48 hours, 7–14 business days in transit, tracking emailed at dispatch.
- Returns: 7 days from delivery for unworn pairs, including size swaps.
- Sizing 350 V2: The 350 V2 fits close to true to size — take your normal US size, and go up a half if you have wide feet. Women's sizes are labelled W.
- Sizing Foam Runner: Foam Runners run big and only come in whole sizes — size down one from your normal US size. If you're between sizes, take the smaller one.
- Sizing Slides: Slides run big and only come in whole sizes — size down one from your normal US size, or two if you like them snug.
- Checkout: Stripe (cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Link). Promo code FIRSTPAIR = 10% off a first pair for email subscribers.
- Contact: info@kicksondeck.store · +1 786 577 8035 · Instagram https://www.instagram.com/kcksondeck

## FAQ
### Are these authentic Yeezys?
No, and we will never tell you otherwise. Kicks on Deck sells independently produced footwear built to the same silhouette — what the community calls "reps." We are not affiliated with, authorized by, or endorsed by adidas, Yeezy, Nike, or any trademark holder. If a store sells the same shoe at this price and calls it authentic, that's the store you should worry about, not this one.

### What does "1:1" actually mean?
It's the community's shorthand for the top production tier — the build that matches the original last, upper texture, stripe placement and sole shape most closely. It is a description of manufacturing quality, not a claim of authenticity. Our rep vs real 350 V2 breakdown shows exactly which details line up and which ones don't, in photos.

### How long does delivery take?
Orders are dispatched within 48 hours. After dispatch, expect 7–14 business days in transit to United States & Canada. You get a tracking number by email the moment the label is created. Full detail on the shipping page.

### What size should I order?
Depends on the silhouette, and it genuinely matters — sizing is the single biggest reason a pair comes back. The 350 V2 fits close to true to size; Foam Runners and Slides run big and only come in whole sizes. Use the size guide before you pick, or the deep-dive guides for the 350 V2, Foam Runner and Slides.

### Can I return them if they don't fit?
Yes. You have 7 days from delivery to start a return on an unworn pair in its original packaging. Read the returns policy for the exact steps and the handful of things we can't take back.

### Is checkout secure?
Card details are entered on Stripe's own hosted checkout page — they never touch this site, and we never see or store a card number. Apple Pay, Google Pay and Link are available if your device supports them.

### Do you ship internationally?
Right now we ship to United States & Canada only. If you're outside that, email us — if there's enough demand for your region we'll open it.

### Do the shoes come in a box?
They ship in a plain protective box with the shoe, its laces and any accessories the style normally includes. We do not supply branded retail boxes, tags or receipts, and we won't pretend otherwise.

### How do I track my order?
Your tracking number arrives by email at dispatch. If it hasn't shown up within 48 hours of ordering, email info@kicksondeck.store with your order number and we'll chase it.

### Can I pay with PayPal or Cash App?
Checkout runs through Stripe, which covers cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Link and — depending on your region — buy-now-pay-later options. If you need a different method, email us before ordering.

### Why are you cheaper than resale?
Because there's no resale market between you and us. Resale prices reflect scarcity and flipper margin, not what a shoe costs to make. We buy from the top production tier, inspect each pair, and price it once.

### Is Kicks on Deck legit?
Yes, and here is what that means in practice. We are an independent store based on South Florida's Treasure Coast with one catalogue, one price per pair, a real inbox at info@kicksondeck.store and a phone line at +1 786 577 8035. Checkout runs through Stripe, every order ships tracked within 48 hours, and you get 7 days from delivery to return an unworn pair. We also say the one thing most rep stores will not: every pair here is a replica, labelled as such, and we are not affiliated with adidas or Yeezy.

### Where is Kicks on Deck located?
South Florida, on the Treasure Coast. We are an online store and ship to United States & Canada; there is no walk-in showroom. If you are searching "sneaker store near me" for this style of shoe, here is what to actually look for.

### Do you sell kids' sizes?
Not yet. The catalogue runs men's US 4 to 13 on the 350 V2 (women's sizes labelled W from W5) and whole sizes on the Foam Runner and Slide. Smaller feet usually work on the 350 V2 in W5 to W7; the Foam Runner sizing guide covers the smallest options there. Vote for kids sizes on the next drop poll and we will stock them when the demand is there.

### Foam Runner or Slide, which is more comfortable?
For all-day walking, the Foam Runner: it wraps the whole foot and the vents keep it cool. For pool, beach and quick errands, the Slide: one strap, on and off in a second, and it dries fast. Both run big and come in whole sizes, so size down one. The full comparison is in Foam Runner vs Slides.

## Shipping & Delivery
Free shipping on every order (US & Canada). No minimum, no threshold to hit, no surprise line item at checkout. The timeline Stage How long Order placed dispatched Within 48 hours In transit 7–14 business days Tracking issued At dispatch, by email Business days are Monday–Friday, excluding public holidays. Orders placed on a weekend are dispatched the next business day. What it costs Nothing. Shipping is free to every address in United States & Canada, on every order, at every price. Shipping shows as a $0.00 line on your Stripe receipt so the total is never a surprise. Where we ship United States & Canada. We do not currently ship anywhere else. If you're outside that, email info@kicksondeck.store — we open new regions when there's enough demand to do it properly. Tracking You'll get a tracking number by email when the label is created. Tracking can take a day or so to show its first scan — that gap is normal and doesn't mean anything is wrong. If a parcel goes quiet Tracking that hasn't updated in five business days is worth an email. Send your order number to info@kicksondeck.store and we'll open a trace with the carrier. If a parcel is confirmed lost, we replace it or refund it in full — your choice. Wrong address We ship to the address Stripe collects at checkout. If you spot a mistake, email us immediately — before dispatch we can fix it for free, after dispatch we're at the carrier's mercy. Duties and customs Prices are what you pay. There is no separate duty or brokerage invoice waiting for you on delivery within United States & Canada. Questions this page didn't answer? The FAQ covers sizing, authenticity and payment, and returns covers what happens if the fit is wrong.

## Returns & Exchanges
You have 7 days from delivery to start a return or a size exchange. Nearly every return we get is a sizing call — so if that's you, no lecture, just send it back. What qualifies Unworn, with the soles clean and unmarked In the original packaging, with laces and any included accessories Started within 7 days of the delivery scan Try them on indoors, on carpet, the way you would in a store. Once a sole has been outside it can't go back into stock. What we can't take back Pairs that have been worn outdoors, washed, customised, or re-laced beyond a normal try-on Care and cleaning products once opened, for hygiene reasons Anything sent back without contacting us first — we won't be able to match it to an order How to start one Email info@kicksondeck.store with your order number and, for an exchange, the size you actually want. We reply with the return address and a reference to write on the parcel. Ship it back with tracking, then send us the tracking number. We inspect on arrival and refund or dispatch the exchange the same day. Refunds Refunds go back to the original payment method through Stripe within three business days of the pair arriving. Your bank usually takes another three to five days to post it. We refund the full price you paid for the item. Return shipping You cover return postage on a change-of-mind return or a size exchange. We cover it entirely if the pair arrived damaged, defective, or is simply not what you ordered — in that case don't post anything, just email us photos first and we'll sort it. Damaged or wrong item Email photos to info@kicksondeck.store within 48 hours of delivery. We'll replace the pair or refund it in full, and we pay the postage in both directions. You keep your original 7-day window on the replacement. Cancelling an order Email us before dispatch — inside the 48-hour window — and we'll cancel and refund in full, no questions. After dispatch it becomes a standard return. Avoid the round trip entirely: the size guide takes two minutes and settles the question for all three silhouettes.

## Size Guide — 350 V2, Foam Runners & Slides
Three silhouettes, three different fits. Get this right and you never think about it again. The short version Silhouette How it fits What to order 350 V2 snug, close to true to size Your normal US size; go up a half if you're wide-footed Foam Runner Runs big, whole sizes only Size down one from your normal US slides Runs big, whole sizes only Size down one; size down two if you like them tight Every pair we sell is unisex. On the 350 V2 women's sizes are labelled W; on Foam Runners and Slides the listed size is the men's US scale, so women subtract roughly 1.5 (a women's 8 is about a men's 6.5). US / UK / EU conversion — men's US UK EU CM 4 3.5 36 22.5 5 4.5 37.3 23.5 6 5.5 38.7 24 7 6.5 40 25 8 7.5 41.3 26 9 8.5 42.7 27 10 9.5 44 28 11 10.5 45.3 29 12 11.5 46.7 30 13 12.5 48 31 US / UK / EU conversion — women's US (W) US (M) UK EU 5 4 3.5 36 6 5 4.5 37.3 7 6 5.5 38.7 8 7 6.5 40 9 8 7.5 41.3 10 9 8.5 42.7 11 10 9.5 44 How to measure your foot properly Stand on a sheet of paper with your heel against a wall, late in the day when your feet are at their largest. Mark the tip of your longest toe — which is not always the big toe. Measure heel to mark in centimetres, then add about 0.5 cm of wearing room. Match that number to the CM column above. Measure both feet and go with the larger one. Most people have a half-size difference and never notice until it matters. Half sizes The 350 V2 comes in half sizes and you should use them. Foam Runners and Slides don't — if you land between sizes on those, take the smaller one, because both stretch and relax with wear while a loose molded shoe never tightens back up. Wide feet The 350 V2's Primeknit gives across the forefoot but the cage over the midfoot doesn't. If you know you're wide, go up a half size on the 350 V2 and stay at your calculated size on the Foam Runner, which is the roomiest thing we sell. Want the long version with photos and the specific edge cases? Read the 350 V2 sizing guide, the Foam Runner sizing guide or the Slides sizing guide. Still unsure — email info@kicksondeck.store with your usual size and brand and we'll tell you what to order.

## About Kicks on Deck
Kicks on Deck is an independent footwear store run out of South Florida's Treasure Coast. We sell 94 styles across three silhouettes — the 350 V2, the Foam Runner and the Slide — at prices that reflect what a shoe costs to make rather than what a resale market decided it's worth this week. We say the quiet part out loud Everything here is a replica. Not "inspired by," not "unauthorised retail," not a wink and a nudge in the product title — a rep, produced independently, sold as such. We are not affiliated with, authorized by, or endorsed by adidas, Yeezy, Nike, or any trademark holder. That honesty is the whole business model. A store that lies about authenticity has to keep lying — about where stock comes from, about why the box is wrong, about why a refund is complicated. We'd rather tell you exactly what you're buying and let the shoe do the arguing. Our rep vs real breakdown puts our own product under the magnifying glass and shows you where it wins and where it doesn't. How a pair gets here Sourced from the top production tier. The rep market runs several quality grades deep. We buy from the highest one — the builds that match the original last, the upper texture, the stripe placement and the sole geometry. It costs more per pair and it's the only part of this we won't compromise on. Inspected before it ships. Every pair is opened, checked for glue marks, stitching faults, sole seating and colour consistency, then repacked. Pairs that fail don't go out. QC photos on request, before dispatch, on any order. Dispatched within 48 hours. Free shipping to United States & Canada, tracked, with a 7-day window if the fit isn't right. What we're not We're not a marketplace, a dropshipper you've never heard of, or a link in someone's bio that disappears next month. There's one catalogue, one price per pair, a real inbox at info@kicksondeck.store, and policies you can read before you spend anything — shipping, returns, FAQ. Why the culture stuff Half this site is a journal — sizing guides, colourway explainers, care instructions, styling. It's there because the questions that stop people buying a $149 pair of sneakers are almost never about the sneakers. They're "will these fit," "how do I keep them clean," "which colourway actually goes with what I own." We wrote all of it so you don't have to ask. Get in touch Sizing help, QC photos, order status, a colourway you want us to stock: info@kicksondeck.store, or the contact page. We answer.
